headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while rate and geopolitical risks sustain Stress
body: NQ is closed for the weekend. Friday's Nasdaq fell 0.52% after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reinforced the inflation fight, while Iran continues to maintain Hormuz restrictions and Russia extended its diesel-export ban. No live NQ path is available; shared Finviz context is stale and excluded.
